hints: Apply Newton's second law horizontally to particle B of mass $0.5\text{ kg}$ on the smooth surface.
The string pulls B with tension $T$ at an angle of $15^\circ$ above the horizontal: $T \cos 15^\circ = m_B a$.
Substitute $m_B = 0.5\text{ kg}$ and $a = 1.2\text{ m s}^{-2}$ to evaluate $T$.
walkthrough:
Step 1: Horizontal forces on particle B.
Particle B of mass $m_B = 0.5\text{ kg}$ is on a smooth horizontal surface (friction is zero). The string tension $T$ pulls B at an angle of $15^\circ$ to the horizontal.
The horizontal component of tension is $T \cos 15^\circ$.

Step 2: Apply Newton's second law:
$$F_{\text{net}} = m_B a$$
$$T \cos 15^\circ = 0.5 \times 1.2 = 0.6$$
$$T = \frac{0.6}{\cos 15^\circ} \approx \frac{0.6}{0.965926} \approx 0.62116\text{ N} \approx 0.621\text{ N}$$

hints: Resolve vertically for block A: $R_A + 6 \sin 20^\circ = 2g + T \sin 15^\circ$, and calculate $R_A \approx 18.11\text{ N}$.
Apply Newton's second law horizontally for block A: $6 \cos 20^\circ - T \cos 15^\circ - F = 2(1.2)$, and solve for the friction force $F \approx 2.638\text{ N}$.
Use $F = \mu R_A$ to calculate the coefficient of friction: $\mu = \frac{2.638}{18.11} \approx 0.146$.
walkthrough:
Step 1: Free-body analysis on block A ($m_A = 2\text{ kg}$).
Forces acting on A:
1. External pulling force: $6\text{ N}$ at $20^\circ$ above the horizontal (forward and upward).
2. Tension $T$ in the string connecting to trailing particle B: acts backward and downward at $15^\circ$ below the horizontal ($T = 0.62116\text{ N}$).
3. Weight: $W_A = m_A g = 2(10) = 20\text{ N}$ vertically downward.
4. Normal reaction: $R_A$ vertically upward.
5. Friction from the rough surface: $F$ opposing horizontal forward motion.

Step 2: Vertical equilibrium for block A:
$$R_A + 6 \sin 20^\circ = 2g + T \sin 15^\circ$$
$$R_A = 20 + T \sin 15^\circ - 6 \sin 20^\circ$$
$$T \sin 15^\circ = 0.62116 \times 0.258819 \approx 0.16077\text{ N}$$
$$6 \sin 20^\circ = 6 \times 0.342020 \approx 2.05212\text{ N}$$
$$R_A = 20 + 0.16077 - 2.05212 = 18.10865\text{ N} \approx 18.11\text{ N}$$

Step 3: Horizontal equation of motion for block A:
$$6 \cos 20^\circ - T \cos 15^\circ - F = m_A a$$
From part (a), $T \cos 15^\circ = 0.6\text{ N}$:
$$6 \cos 20^\circ - 0.6 - F = 2(1.2)$$
$$6(0.939693) - 0.6 - F = 2.4$$
$$5.63816 - 0.6 - F = 2.4$$
$$5.03816 - F = 2.4$$
$$F = 5.03816 - 2.4 = 2.63816\text{ N} \approx 2.638\text{ N}$$

Step 4: Solve for the coefficient of friction $\mu$:
$$\mu = \frac{F}{R_A} = \frac{2.63816}{18.10865} \approx 0.14568 \approx 0.146$$
